description: This Java source file defines the Config class for Spring Boot configuration of the Eclipse Kura protocol adapter, including bean definitions, property configuration, and metrics setup.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class setting up beans, metrics, and properties for the Kura protocol adapter.

methods.name: kuraProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Creates a new instance of KuraProtocolAdapter bean with prototype scope.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamSenderFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets default name for downstream sender factory client config if not provided.

methods.name: customizeRegistrationClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets default name for registration client factory config if not provided.

methods.name: customizeCredentialsClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets default name for credentials client factory config if not provided.

methods.name: customizeTenantClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets default name for tenant client factory config if not provided.

methods.name: adapterProperties
methods.description: Defines and exposes KuraAdapterProperties bean with 'hono.kura' prefix.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Configures the MeterRegistry with common tags specific to the Kura protocol adapter.

methods.name: adapterMetrics
methods.description: Provides an instance of MicrometerBasedMqttAdapterMetrics configured with the registry.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Creates an ObjectFactoryCreatingFactoryBean to instantiate the KuraProtocolAdapter bean.
